NOTE
**Still not ready — screenshots added, but the approach is still being debated**

New: The author added before/after screenshots to the PR description, which covers the earlier feedback, and there is no new push. Missing: Sahil Batra's CZO objection is unanswered, because he wants the API to accept any casing and normalize to the canonical language, while this PR rejects capitals. The work is also one large commit across 14 files (backend, migration, frontend, API docs, tests), which doesn't follow commit discipline.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign a reviewer yet. Ask the author to settle the approach with Sahil Batra on CZO, then split the work into coherent commits.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the screenshots! Before this is ready for review, please settle the approach with Sahil in the CZO thread (he suggested accepting any casing and normalizing it, rather than rejecting capitals), and then split this into separate commits following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html).
```
